findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption setting may be stored without configured encryption at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL does not provide encryption for stored ledger export data.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not ensure that artifact data is encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without explicit encryption may not receive a bucket-enforced encryption setting.
